statements.impact_statement: CVE-2026-53489 (GHSA-rgh6-rfwx-v388, GO-2026-5622): when containerd's CRI plugin restores a container from a checkpoint image, it copied container.log back without validating a symlinked path, so reading the container's logs (kubectl logs) could return an arbitrary host file. It is fixed in containerd 2.1.9, 2.2.5 and 2.3.2; on the release/2.2 branch, from which 2.2.5 is cut, the fix is commit 3576522 (cri: make checkpoint restore robust to unexpected archive content), which changes only files in the CRI plugin's server package, internal/cri/server: https://github.com/containerd/containerd/security/advisories/GHSA-rgh6-rfwx-v388, https://github.com/containerd/containerd/commit/357652293053d0cd3ed565f718b0050aa662ae1a, https://pkg.go.dev/vuln/GO-2026-5622. Read the Go build information and the function table of every Go program in every build-dev package published in the DHI Alpine 3.23 repository: 89 builds, 2.6.4-r0 through the current 2.29.1-r1, each for x86_64 and aarch64 except 2.6.4-r0, which is published for aarch64 only, every download checked against the index checksum. Each package holds one file, the Go program /usr/bin/build. Version 2.19.1-r1 is listed three times in each index, every entry with the same source commit and installed size as 2.19.1-r0; the copy the repository serves was read. The build information of /usr/bin/build lists github.com/containerd/containerd/v2 (2.2.0 through 2.3.7 across the builds), but the vulnerable code was not linked in. In every build, the only containerd packages in the function table are the registry resolver (core/remotes/docker with its auth and errors packages), pkg/reference, pkg/identifiers, internal/lazyregexp and version, and no function table contains any of containerd's CRI plugin code (internal/cri, pkg/cri or plugins/cri).

CVE-2026-53489 (GO-2026-5622, GHSA-rgh6-rfwx-v388): containerd's CRI plugin restores container.log and other files from a checkpoint image without refusing a symlinked path, so restoring a crafted checkpoint can expose an arbitrary host file through the container log. It affects github.com/containerd/containerd/v2 2.1.0 to 2.1.8, 2.2.0 to 2.2.4 and 2.3.0 to 2.3.1, and the Go vulnerability database lists the vulnerable symbols as criService.CRImportCheckpoint, criService.CreateContainer and criService.StartContainer in the package github.com/containerd/containerd/v2/internal/cri/server. The fix commit changes only files in that package (container_checkpoint_linux.go and container_start.go): https://pkg.go.dev/vuln/GO-2026-5622, https://github.com/containerd/containerd/security/advisories/GHSA-rgh6-rfwx-v388, https://github.com/containerd/containerd/commit/8196411f24065533093be4c7ad874c23b06178f3 (on main). This package does not contain that code. We read every published trivy-dev package in the DHI Alpine 3.23 repository: 38 builds, 0.69.1-r0 to 0.74.0-r12, each for x86_64 and aarch64, each verified against its index checksum. Each package installs a single file, /usr/bin/trivy, a statically linked Go program. Its Go build information lists github.com/containerd/containerd v1.7.29 to v1.7.32 (builds 0.69.1-r0 to 0.70.0-r6) and github.com/containerd/containerd/v2 v2.2.0 to v2.3.7 (every build). The function table (go tool nm) of all 76 binaries has no function from any containerd internal/cri, pkg/cri or plugins/cri package in either module, so none of the three listed symbols and none of the functions the fix changes is present, while runtime.main is found in every binary. A raw byte search of all 76 binaries also finds no containerd internal/cri, pkg/cri or plugins/cri path and no CRImportCheckpoint, criService or container_checkpoint string, while it finds runtime.main and the containerd v2 client and core/images packages in every binary. The containerd code trivy links is the client side (the client package, core/content, core/images, core/remotes and related core and pkg packages), not the CRI plugin. As a positive control, the same function-table and byte searches, run on /usr/bin/containerd from the containerd 2.4.2-r5 package in the DHI Alpine 3.23 repository on x86_64 and aarch64, find 1,712 CRI plugin functions in each, including internal/cri/server.(*criService).CreateContainer, (*criService).StartContainer, (*criService).CheckpointContainer and copyNoFollow, the helper the fix adds.
